Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
